d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne sivan jila sthit mamta medikal kolej aur aspatal ke udghatan tatha 'vhait kot seremni' ke shubharanbh karyakram men hissa liya. is dauran unhonne svasthy sevaon se lekar uchch shiksha tak kaee aham baten sajha kin.
Aayushman bharat se 97% garib parivar jure, har jile men vishvavidyalay ki kalpana
